verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of granular user permissions or roles for viewing or editing projects and tasks. The only related item covers scoped permissions for AI agents, managed from a console that also governs human users. That is an adjacent agent-governance feature, not documented view/edit role control over work, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work

citations.quote: Every agent has an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints
